name: Ava Capital Plc
source: AVA Capital Partners Plc (NGX ticker AVACAP) audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, signed by KPMG Professional Services (Oseme Obaloje, FRC/2013/PRO/ICAN/004/00000004803), audit report dated 31 March 2026, published on the issuer's own investor relations site. The Company column is used, not the Group column: the printed Group lines do not tie while the Company column ties exactly in both years.
unit: NGN, absolute. The issuer prints in thousands of Nigerian Naira, so every value here is the printed figure multiplied by 1,000 (the earlier copy of this file carried the printed thousands figure unscaled, which made the panel show the company 1,000 times smaller than it is). Revenue is the printed Total operating income line. Operating Expenses is the printed Personnel expenses plus Depreciation on property and equipment plus Operating expenses plus Impairment charge for credit loss, which is what makes Revenue less Operating Expenses equal the printed Profit before tax: the Company column carries no interest expense. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are withheld because a capital market operator prints no cost of sales line. Income Tax is the printed Income tax expense with the issuer's own sign, so Profit Before Tax plus Income Tax equals the printed Profit after tax. EPS is withheld: the printed per-share line could not be read unambiguously across its two columns.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Personnel expenses + Depreciation on property and equipment + Operating expenses + Impairment charge for credit loss (printed lines)

checks.revenueLessOpex: 1270679 less 596023 equals 674656, the printed Profit before tax; 331302 less 334941 equals -3639, the printed Profit before tax
checks.pbtLessTax: 674656 less 173978 equals 500678, the printed Profit after tax; -3639 less 17317 equals -20956, the printed Profit after tax

note: Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are withheld because the issuer prints no cost of sales line; it is a capital market operator. EPS withheld: the printed basic and diluted earnings per share line could not be read unambiguously across its Group and Company columns.
